The full list is in CHANGELOG.md."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"kb-rag runs in the DSH desktop app. Install it from the plugin panel. The command-line routes exist "},{"id":"p23s2","text":"for maintainers and old web deployments; new users do not need them."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"### Engine capabilities"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"- Chunking is section-aware: abstracts get weight 1.5, methods 1.2. It also handles inline headings,"},{"id":"p25s2","text":" abstract promotion, caption blocks and paragraph merging for non-article documents.
- Retrieval com"},{"id":"p25s3","text":"bines BM25 (with CJK bigrams), bge-small vector cosine, RRF fusion and section weights.
- Reranking "},{"id":"p25s4","text":"uses bge-reranker-base to cut the top 20 down to 3, with a bge-large-en bi-encoder as fallback.
- Ev"},{"id":"p25s5","text":"ery passage carries its PDF page and section. The page renders as `section · p.N` and maps onto Zote"},{"id":"p25s6","text":"ro's `?page=N` link.
- In-text `[n]` markers resolve to reference entries. Nature-style superscripts"},{"id":"p25s7","text":" are detected from font metrics, so `graphene1,2` becomes `graphene[1,2]`. Cited works are matched b"},{"id":"p25s8","text":"y DOI, normalised title, or first author plus year, and in-library matches are marked.
- SHA-256 has"},{"id":"p25s9","text":"hes skip unchanged files (about 40× faster on re-runs) and catch duplicate copies across folders.
- "},{"id":"p25s10","text":"Each document records the parser revision that wrote it (`docs.indexed_with`), so `kb_stats` can rep"},{"id":"p25s11","text":"ort rows an older revision left behind.
- Identical queries hit a cache. Any ingest or engine rebuil"},{"id":"p25s12","text":"d clears it.
- The engine runs as a resident daemon. Models load once, the daemon recovers from cras"},{"id":"p25s13","text":"hes, and it is released when the plugin stops.
- If the library's vectors were built with a differen"},{"id":"p25s14","text":"t embedding model, retrieval stops with an explicit error instead of falling back to keyword search."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"## Architecture"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"## Known limitations"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"- Scanned PDFs are not supported. Documents without a text layer are skipped; OCR is out of scope.
-"},{"id":"p29s2","text":" Page anchors are PDF-only. TXT, MD and DOCX files, and documents indexed before schema v3, fall bac"},{"id":"p29s3","text":"k to section-level location until re-ingested with `force`.
- Citation linking requires a re-ingest."},{"id":"p29s4","text":" Superscript detection and reference splitting run at parse time.
- Metadata is only as good as the "},{"id":"p29s5","text":"PDF. It is never 100% accurate; when it is missing, title and year are judged from the cover page, a"},{"id":"p29s6","text":"nd existing Zotero metadata is preferred.
- Captions are searchable as text; content that exists onl"},{"id":"p29s7","text":"y inside a figure is not.
- Keyword matching is in memory. Beyond a few hundred thousand chunks, FAI"},{"id":"p29s8","text":"SS HNSW or SQLite FTS5 would be the next step.
- Some publishers redirect automated PDF requests to "},{"id":"p29s9","text":"a login page. `kb_fetch` reports the failure and leaves the manual path (download, then `kb_ingest`)"},{"id":"p29s10","text":"_fetch` reports the failure and leaves the manual path (download, then `kb_ingest`) as the fallback."}],"truncated":true}
